query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 10 countries by second-tier depth, where the plotted value is `(sum of scores of cities ranked 2 through 5 in each 3.2 national block) / (score of the rank-1 city)`, values are expressed as multiples, only countries with at least 5 listed cities are eligible, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest after the ratio is computed.
